panels.title: Blocks Received vs Block INVs Received

panels.description: verificationProgress is 0..1. initialBlockDownload is a 0/1 flag, scaled by 1000 so it stays visible on the same axis.
panels.title: Chain Verification & Sync State

panels.description: The gap between them is header download that has not been validated yet.
panels.title: Header vs Block Height

panels.description: m_chain_tx_count at the tip, emitted every minute from EmitPeriodicStats.
panels.title: Transactions In Chain

panels.description: BIP9 version bit field of the last block CheckBlock'd. The only per-block gauge with no panel. It is set when the block is checked, so it lags the tip by one block.
panels.title: Current Block Version

panels.description: The only warning counter in the codebase. Should be flat zero; any non-zero means this node was handed a block that failed validation.
panels.title: Invalid Block Warnings

panels.description: Block file reads and writes. These are counters, so Graphite reports per-second rates.
panels.title: Block File I/O Throughput

panels.description: Previously only visible as log lines. Sustained non-zero means disk corruption or I/O errors.
panels.title: Block Disk Failures

panels.description: Flushing the block index (FlushBlockFile) and writing the undo file, both inside ConnectTip.
panels.title: Block Index & Undo Write Latency

panels.description: Normalised by blocks.connected, so this is workload per block rather than per second. Unlike the current-block gauges, these describe work actually validated.
panels.title: Connected Block Workload

panels.description: Whether the mempool/extrapool cache actually made the compact block complete. A rising 'failed' share means relay is paying a round trip.
panels.title: Compact Block Reconstruction Quality

panels.description: Fires when a peer fails to deliver a requested block in time.
panels.title: Block Download Timeouts

panels.description: FindFilesToPrune walks the whole block index. A slow scan is the usual explanation for a prune-induced flush stall.
panels.title: Prune Scan Cost

panels.description: Frequency and depth of reorganisations. Depth is normalised per reorg so one deep reorg is distinguishable from many shallow ones.
panels.title: Reorgs
